title: Meteorite
body:
Description


Meteorite is a relatively uncommon ore that can only spawn in Meteorite nodes inside of Meteor Crash Sites.

The raw form of Meteorite has two different appearances, rock and ore. Meteorite rock is reminiscent of Flameslate, but darker. Meteorite ore is the same as the rock but also has small spherical nodes of slate containing bright red chunks of ore, which have a pulsing particle effect. Refined Meteorite is distinctly reflective and bright red, appearing to be the only ore in the game that has reflections like it does. Forged Meteorite is simply bright red metal.

When sold raw, it is worth around $25 a stud. When refined, it is worth around $44 a stud. When forged, it is worth around $60 a stud.

Like any other materials in the game, you can use refined and forged Meteorite to complete schematics.
